publicSafety.included: Capture-date population arithmetic, date and visibility-label aggregates, annual counts, aggregate URL and host counts, overlapping mission-signal counts, selected professional source-route leads, bounded public-stakeholder reference counts, classifier rules, and a SHA-256 digest of the protected record set.
publicSafety.excluded: Raw post text, item-level post URLs except separately governed professional source specimens, ordinary identities, comments, reactions, personal-life chronology, private or malformed URLs, images, local paths, cookies, session data, and authenticated state.
publicSafety.rawCaptureLocation: protected pointer outside the public repository
publicSafety.reason: A row-level personal Facebook ledger would reconstruct private and ordinary life context. The public artifact preserves the research contract and professional retrieval signals without becoming a personal-history index.

populationReconciliation.filter: Posted by You; all years; all privacy states
populationReconciliation.conclusion: Every one of the 1,243 authored-post cards materialized by the filtered Manage Posts surface was reviewed, and the terminal count remained stable at the oldest dated card with no loading indicator.
populationReconciliation.boundary: This is a complete review of the capture-date authored-post population exposed to the authenticated owner on July 16, 2026. It is not a native account export and does not establish that no post was deleted, withheld, or otherwise absent before capture.

visibilityLabelCounts.boundary: An absent compact-card label is unknown, not public. Public-only findings use the 671 cards explicitly labeled Public.

availability.boundary: An unavailable source card remains part of the population but does not support a content proposition.

postedUrlInventory.boundary: A posted URL establishes publication or redistribution, not authorship of the destination, endorsement, readership, conversion, participation, or impact. Only selected professional routes are exposed; the full item-level URL inventory remains protected.

missionSignalInventory.boundary: These are overlapping retrieval signals, not measures of labor, project priority, authorship of shared cards, reach, or impact. Zero results for a project name do not establish that Jamie never posted about that project.

stakeholderReferenceInventory.boundary: A reference establishes that an explicitly public post named or addressed a stakeholder group. It is not incoming engagement, endorsement, collaboration confirmation, or an audience count.

eventCardSocialContext.boundary: The compact Facebook event cards rendered social-context phrases such as 'and N friends.' These figures are volatile interface context, not attendance, RSVPs, unique people reached, post engagement, endorsement, or impact.

tractionBoundary.finding: The complete Manage Posts surface did not expose reactions, comments, shares, or incoming engager identities. No full-population Facebook engagement total is claimed from this pass.
tractionBoundary.nextResearch: If a purpose requires engagement analysis, reconcile a minimized native account export or inspect a bounded, Jamie-approved professional subset without indexing ordinary personal engagement.
